name: Darien Parks & Recreation Youth Summer Camps
description_short: The Town of Darien runs four youth summer camps grouped by grade: Stony Brook Camp (Grade 1), Settlers Camp (Grades 2–3) and Mather Camp (Grades 4–6) at Tokeneke Elementary School, and Middle School Camp (Grades 7–9) at The Depot, Darien's youth center. Campers are placed by the grade they will enter in the fall.
